feature_contract.goal: Accept a sequence-matched real game-present acknowledgment even when the frame producer publishes at the OpenXR host's absolute wait deadline; reject unrelated old-frame wakeups without extending the XR frame budget.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the native R23 OpenXR host's exact game-present acknowledgement cadence wait and its portable regression; do not alter rendered eye geometry, R84/R26 game DLLs, FFB, original input, SkyGlow, DX11, or frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Reproducible deterministic native C++ smoke: an exact ACK becomes visible only on the third shared-state read after the stale event consumes the remaining frame budget. Prior implementation returned false immediately at deadline and dropped an already-presented matching frame.
trace_stages: Actual OutRun D3D9 game-frame producer publishes the shared sequence-validated presented request completion before the OpenXR host eye submission.
R23 OpenXR host receives auto-reset cadence event, calls sequence-matching shared-state reader, and consumes an absolute remaining frame wait budget via CadenceWait::AwaitPresented.
At the deadline a final immediate sequence read accepts only the exact completed request; stale wakeups and nonmatching frames still time out with no extra blocking wait or frame-budget reset.
subcomponents: Native vrhost/src/runtime/cadence_presented_wait.hpp changes the absolute-deadline return path to one final sequence-validated request check without renewing the deadline.

Native vrhost/tests/cadence_presented_wait_smoke.cpp exercises a deterministic stale wake followed by exact deadline ACK and a negative no-ACK timeout while preserving existing stale/ready/error cases.
All real host OpenXR call sites continue to use the original WaitEvent semantics, shared request identity and absolute budget; no D3D9 DLL, FFB or fallbacks are rewritten.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: An unrelated completion never counts as a new game frame; total blocking wait respects the original fixed frame budget, with deterministic stale/deadline negative native C++ smoke coverage.

diagnosis.root_cause: CadenceWait::AwaitPresented correctly rechecked exact shared request identity after auto-reset wake, but its now >= deadline guard returned false immediately after a prior nonmatching read. A real game-present completion could arrive between those reads and be mistaken for a frame timeout.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Existing native game request ACK uses shared sequence matching and an absolute OpenXR wait budget; commit c5bc48ab adds a fail-before/pass-after deterministic third-read boundary case, plus a never-matching timeout case.
source_trace: R23 x64 OpenXR host invokes AwaitPresented for the current game-present sequence, ignoring stale auto-reset event signals.
vrhost/src/runtime/cadence_presented_wait.hpp checks matches, then reads the clock; the previous deadline path skipped any final shared-state verification.
Current exact deadline path returns matches() for that sequence only, preserving the existing deadline and fallback without extra WaitEvent calls.
alternatives_rejected: Do not increase OpenXR wait budget or spin through another loop; this hides the false loss with additional latency.
Do not trust auto-reset event alone; a previous game frame may trigger the same event and corrupt the current request identity.
Do not globally modify eye rendering, D3D9 Reset/FFB, SkyGlow, or frozen DXVK for this bounded host cadence race.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Native cadence_presented_wait_smoke.cpp has a deterministic fail-before third read on exact deadline and verifies no extra wake/block for a never-matching request; existing cases reject stale events and check early-ready/failed-wait.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Existing material C++ commit c5bc48ab04ce01677eb803a1cad46ef9bc16d116 changes the real host deadline branch and extends native regression; exact-SHA automated build validation is pending after required run-record repair.
diagnosis.runtime_evidence: Actual OutRun game and Quest3/VDXR were not run; no visual/performance improvement claimed without matching headset measurements.
diagnosis.next_hmd_experiment: Check exact R84 build through real Quest3/VDXR frame pacing and duplicate/headlock HUD while gaming, compare timed-out/matched frames, p95/p99 stalls and input/FFB stability against control.
